title: Dialogue Bad Effect of Smoking
excerpt: Rafi: My older cousin has started smoking because he thinks it makes him look mature.
plainContent: A warning about tobacco Rafi: My older cousin has started smoking because he thinks it makes him look mature. Joya: Tobacco does not prove maturity. It contains addictive substances and exposes the body to harmful chemicals. Rafi: What damage can it cause? Joya: It raises the risk of lung disease, heart problems, stroke, and several cancers. Smoke also harms people nearby, especially children. Money spent on cigarettes could support food, books, or savings. Rafi: Some people say they can stop whenever they wish. Joya: Dependence makes quitting difficult, but support from a doctor, family, or cessation programme can help. Avoiding triggers and replacing the habit with exercise or another activity is useful. Rafi: We should not tease someone who is trying to quit. Joya: Right. Encouragement is more helpful than shame. Young people should learn the facts before advertising or peer pressure influences them. Rafi: I will share reliable health information with my cousin and ask whether he wants help.

title: Food Adulteration paragraph for Class 6,7,8, HSC, SSC
excerpt: Food adulteration occurs when sellers mix inferior, contaminated, or harmful substances into food or use unsafe chemicals to make it look better or last
plainContent: The danger of adulterated food Food adulteration occurs when sellers mix inferior, contaminated, or harmful substances into food or use unsafe chemicals to make it look better or last longer. Milk, spices, oil, fruit, fish, sweets, and packaged products can all be affected. Eating such food may cause immediate stomach problems and can damage organs after repeated exposure. Children, older people, and those with weak health face particular risks. Adulteration is therefore not a minor business offence; it threatens public health. Consumers should buy from reliable sources, inspect packaging, check dates, wash produce, and be cautious about unnatural colours or unusually low prices. Authorities must test food, inspect businesses, punish offenders, and educate the public. Honest sellers and informed buyers can help create a safer food market.

title: Drug Addiction Paragraph for Class 6-12, SSC, HSC
excerpt: Drug addiction begins when repeated use of a substance changes a person’s body and behaviour. What starts as curiosity or pressure from friends can become
plainContent: Protecting young people from drugs Drug addiction begins when repeated use of a substance changes a person’s body and behaviour. What starts as curiosity or pressure from friends can become dependence. An addicted person may lose interest in study, work, health, and family responsibilities. The effects include illness, financial hardship, broken relationships, accidents, and crime. A family should not hide the problem or wait until it becomes severe. Doctors, counsellors, and treatment centres can provide safer and more effective help. Education, sports, creative activities, caring relationships, and honest conversations can prevent many young people from experimenting. Authorities must stop illegal trafficking while making treatment available to those who need it. We should reject drugs firmly but treat affected people with humanity so that they can seek recovery.

title: A Friend in Need is a Friend Indeed Completing story for all classes
excerpt: Two travellers were walking through a forest when they heard a bear approaching. One man quickly climbed a tree and left his companion on the ground. The other
plainContent: Tested beside the forest path Two travellers were walking through a forest when they heard a bear approaching. One man quickly climbed a tree and left his companion on the ground. The other remembered that a bear is unlikely to touch a person who appears lifeless, so he held his breath and remained still. The bear came close, examined him, and then moved away. When the danger had passed, the man in the tree climbed down and jokingly asked what the bear had whispered. His companion replied that the animal had advised him never to trust a person who abandons a friend in danger. The words were calm, but the lesson was serious. Friendship is not measured by cheerful conversations or shared meals. It is revealed when help is inconvenient and fear is real. A dependable friend offers support instead of searching for personal safety first. Moral: A true friend stands beside us during difficulty.

title: Computer Paragraph for Class 6,7,8, SSC and HSC

plainContent: The value of learning computer skills Computers help people complete many tasks accurately and quickly. A learner can type an assignment, organize information, calculate expenses, draw a chart, or attend an online class with the same device. Offices, hospitals, banks, shops, and schools all depend on computer-based work. Knowing how to use a computer also broadens access to knowledge. Students can consult digital libraries and practise languages, while job seekers can prepare applications and develop professional skills. Format of an Application for Leave of Absence A leave application follows the usual format of a formal application to the headteacher or principal. Each part has a fixed place, so learn the order first and then practise writing the full application. The main parts are given below. Date Name and designation of the headteacher Name of the school Subject of the application Salutation, such as "Sir/Madam" Body of the application Closing, such as "Yours obediently" Name, class, roll number and date of the student Leave of absence means permission to stay away from school for a few days. In the body you must clearly write the dates of your absence, the reason for it, and what you will do about the lessons you miss. A short and honest application is always better than a long one. Application for Leave of Absence (Example) To The Headteacher [School Name] Subject: Application for leave of absence Sir/Madam, I could not attend school from [date] to [date] because I was suffering from fever. A doctor advised me to take complete rest for a few days, and my guardian informed the school as soon as my illness became clear. I am now well enough to return to my classes. During my illness I stayed at home and took the medicine the doctor prescribed. My parents looked after me carefully, and I followed the doctor's advice about food and rest. That is why I have recovered quickly and I am ready to join my classes again. Please excuse my absence for the stated period. I have collected the class notes from a classmate and I will complete the lessons, homework and class tests that I missed. I have also asked my teachers about the lessons I missed. A medical certificate is enclosed with this application, as the school may wish to see it. I shall be grateful if you kindly grant me leave for the stated period. I promise to attend my classes regularly from now on and to work hard to make up for the lessons I have missed. plainContent: On this page you will find an application for a testimonial for Class 6, 7, 8, SSC and HSC students. A Bangla meaning, important word meanings and exam tips are given at the end. Format of an Application for a Testimonial A testimonial application follows the usual format of a formal application to the headmaster or principal. Each part has a fixed place, so learn the order first and then practise writing the full application. The main parts are given below. Date Name and designation of the headmaster or principal Name and address of the school Subject of the application Salutation, such as "Sir" Body of the application Closing, such as "Yours obediently" Name, class and roll number of the student A testimonial is an official paper from your school or college. It describes your conduct, your academic record and the period of your study there. Students usually need it after SSC or HSC, when they apply for college admission or higher studies, so write the application in clear and polite language. Application for a Testimonial (Example) 18 July 2025 The Headmaster Pabna Zilla School Pabna Subject: Request for a testimonial Sir, I respectfully state that I was a student of your school in Class Ten during the academic year 2024–2025. I completed the Secondary School Certificate examination from this institution, and I have now been admitted to a college. The college authorities have asked me to submit a testimonial describing my conduct and academic record. I maintained regular attendance, followed the rules of the school, and took part in academic and co-curricular activities. My teachers guided me with care, and I always tried to behave politely with my classmates. I also took part in the annual sports and cultural programmes of the school whenever I got the chance. During my time at school I learned not only from my lessons but also from my teachers and friends. The school taught me discipline, honesty and respect for others. I will always remember these lessons and try to follow them in my college life. I therefore request you to issue me a testimonial at your earliest convenience. I shall remain grateful to you for your kind help. I hope the testimonial will help me complete my college admission without delay. Yours obediently, Rahim Class: Ten Roll: 12 Bangla Meaning of the Application for a Testimonial প্রশংসাপত্রের আবেদনের বাংলা অর্থ আমি বিনীতভাবে জানাচ্ছি যে আমি ২০২৪–২০২৫ শিক্ষাবর্ষে আপনার স্কুলের দশম শ্রেণির ছাত্র ছিলাম। আমি এই প্রতিষ্ঠান থেকে মাধ্যমিক স্কুল সার্টিফিকেট পরীক্ষা সম্পন্ন করেছি এবং এখন একটি কলেজে ভর্তি হয়েছি। কলেজ কর্তৃপক্ষ আমার আচরণ ও শিক্ষাগত ফলাফল সম্পর্কে একটি প্রশংসাপত্র জমা দিতে বলেছে। আমি নিয়মিত উপস্থিত থেকেছি, স্কুলের নিয়ম মেনে চলেছি এবং পড়াশোনা ও সহপাঠক্রমিক কার্যক্রমে অংশ নিয়েছি। শিক্ষকরা যত্ন করে আমাকে পথ দেখিয়েছেন এবং আমি সবসময় সহপাঠীদের সঙ্গে ভদ্রভাবে আচরণ করার চেষ্টা করেছি। সুযোগ পেলেই আমি স্কুলের বার্ষিক ক্রীড়া ও সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠানেও অংশ নিয়েছি। স্কুলে থাকার সময় আমি শুধু পাঠ থেকেই নয়, শিক্ষক ও বন্ধুদের কাছ থেকেও অনেক কিছু শিখেছি। স্কুল আমাকে শৃঙ্খলা, সততা ও অন্যদের প্রতি সম্মান শিখিয়েছে। আমি এই শিক্ষাগুলো সবসময় মনে রাখব এবং কলেজ জীবনেও সেগুলো মেনে চলার চেষ্টা করব। তাই আমি অনুরোধ করছি, আপনি যেন যত তাড়াতাড়ি সম্ভব আমাকে একটি প্রশংসাপত্র দেন। আপনার এই সাহায্যের জন্য আমি কৃতজ্ঞ থাকব। প্রশংসাপত্রটি পেলে আমার কলেজে ভর্তি দেরি না করে সম্পন্ন হবে বলে আমি আশা করি। Important Word Meanings Learn these words before you write the application. They will help you understand the example and write similar applications in your own words. title: Traffic Jam Paragraph for class 6,7,8, SSC
excerpt: A traffic jam is a long queue of vehicles moving slowly or not at all. It is common in crowded cities where the number of cars, buses, trucks, rickshaws, and
plainContent: Traffic Jam A traffic jam is a long queue of vehicles moving slowly or not at all. It is common in crowded cities where the number of cars, buses, trucks, rickshaws, and motorcycles has grown faster than the roads and transport systems. Narrow streets, road repairs, illegal parking, roadside markets, poor signals, and careless driving make congestion worse. A jam wastes valuable time and fuel. Students may miss classes, workers arrive late, and patients can face dangerous delays. Exhaust fumes increase air pollution, while constant horns create stress and noise. Goods also reach shops more slowly, raising business costs. Better public transport can reduce the number of private vehicles. Authorities should improve traffic signals, create safe footpaths and parking areas, remove illegal obstructions, and enforce lane and stopping rules. Traffic police need effective training and equipment. Citizens should plan journeys, avoid blocking intersections, and follow directions patiently. Long-term city planning that places homes, workplaces, and services near reliable transport is essential. Cooperation between planners, drivers, pedestrians, and businesses can make urban travel safer and faster.

title: A Thirsty Crow completing story For Class 6,7,8, SSC and HSC

plainContent: Resourcefulness beside the jar On a hot day a crow searched for water and found a narrow jar. A little water lay at the bottom, but the bird’s beak could not reach it. It tried to tip the jar, yet the vessel was too heavy. It also searched around the yard for another source and found none. Instead of giving up, the crow noticed small pebbles nearby. It carried them to the jar one by one and dropped them inside. Slowly the water rose until it reached the rim. The crow drank safely and flew away. The solution was not quick, but patient observation turned a difficult problem into a manageable task. When the first plan fails, a person can examine the materials at hand, think step by step, and continue working rather than complain. Moral: Intelligence, patience, and perseverance can overcome obstacles.

HSC GPA Calculator Bangladesh 2026 The HSC GPA Calculator helps students estimate their Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Grade Point Average from their subject results. You can enter either your letter grades or your marks . The calculator converts your marks into the corresponding grade points and calculates your overall GPA. It supports the three main HSC groups: Science Business Studies Humanities The calculator also supports the 4th or optional subject , allowing the applicable bonus to be included automatically. If you already have your marks or grades, enter them above to get your estimated HSC GPA. How to Calculate HSC GPA Bangladesh's HSC grading system uses a 5.00-point scale . Each subject result is converted into a letter grade and corresponding grade point. For example: 80–100 marks = A+ = 5.00 70–79 marks = A = 4.00 60–69 marks = A− = 3.50 50–59 marks = B = 3.00 40–49 marks = C = 2.00 33–39 marks = D = 1.00 0–32 marks = F = 0.00 The official Education Board grading table uses this marks-to-grade-point scale. For the main subjects, the grade points are used to determine the student's GPA. If an optional or 4th subject is included, the applicable bonus is added according to the grading rules. Simple example Suppose a student receives these grade points: Subject Grade Grade Point Bangla A+ 5.00 English A 4.00 ICT A+ 5.00 Physics A+ 5.00 Chemistry A 4.00 Biology A+ 5.00 The grade points from the main subjects are used to calculate the student's GPA. If the student also has an optional subject, the 4th-subject rule is applied before the final GPA is determined. HSC Grading System in Bangladesh The HSC grading system uses a 5.00 GPA scale. The following table shows the standard marks-to-grade conversion used by Bangladesh's Education Boards. Marks Letter Grade Grade Point 80–100 A+ 5.00 70–79 A 4.00 60–69 A− 3.50 50–59 B 3.00 40–49 C 2.00 33–39 D 1.00 0–32 F 0.00 What do the grades mean? A+ (5.00) The highest grade point on the HSC grading scale. A (4.00) A strong result with a grade point of 4.00. A− (3.50) A grade point of 3.50. B (3.00) A grade point of 3.00. C (2.00) A grade point of 2.00. D (1.00) The minimum passing grade. F (0.00) A failing grade in the subject. HSC 4th Subject Bonus: How Does It Work? The 4th subject, also called the optional subject , is treated differently from the main subjects. When the grade point earned in the optional subject is above 2.00 , the amount above 2.00 is treated as the bonus. For example: Optional subject grade point = 5.00 Then: 5.00 − 2.00 = 3.00 bonus points Similarly: Optional subject grade point = 4.00 4.00 − 2.00 = 2.00 bonus points And: Optional subject grade point = 3.50 3.50 − 2.00 = 1.50 bonus points The bonus is then incorporated into the overall GPA calculation according to the applicable HSC rules. Our calculator applies the 4th-subject calculation automatically, so you do not need to calculate the bonus manually.
